+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from pathlib import Path
+import csv
+
+
+INPUT_DIR = Path("/Users/linqingxuan/maftools-mcp/ANNOVAR_test/annovar_skill+maftools-mcp")
+OUTPUT = Path("/Users/linqingxuan/maftools-mcp/Use-case_evaluation&repeated-run_performance/gpt-5.5/case_01/run_05/outputs/merged_vcf_cohort.maf")
+
+
+def parse_info(info):
+    fields = {}
+    for item in info.split(";"):
+        if "=" in item:
+            key, value = item.split("=", 1)
+            fields[key] = value.replace("\\x3b", ";")
+        else:
+            fields[item] = True
+    return fields
+
+
+def first_value(value):
+    if not value or value == ".":
+        return "."
+    return value.split(",", 1)[0].split(";", 1)[0]
+
+
+def split_aa_change(value):
+    if not value or value == ".":
+        return ".", ".", ".", "."
+    first = value.split(",", 1)[0]
+    parts = first.split(":")
+    gene = parts[0] if len(parts) > 0 else "."
+    tx = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
+    exon = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "."
+    tx_change = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else "."
+    aa_change = parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else "."
+    return tx, exon, tx_change, aa_change
+
+
+def variant_type(ref, alt):
+    if len(ref) == 1 and len(alt) == 1:
+        return "SNP"
+    if len(ref) < len(alt):
+        return "INS"
+    if len(ref) > len(alt):
+        return "DEL"
+    return "ONP"
+
+
+def variant_classification(func, exonic_func):
+    exonic = first_value(exonic_func)
+    functional = first_value(func)
+    mapping = {
+        "nonsynonymous_SNV": "Missense_Mutation",
+        "synonymous_SNV": "Silent",
+        "stopgain": "Nonsense_Mutation",
+        "stoploss": "Nonstop_Mutation",
+        "frameshift_deletion": "Frame_Shift_Del",
+        "frameshift_insertion": "Frame_Shift_Ins",
+        "nonframeshift_deletion": "In_Frame_Del",
+        "nonframeshift_insertion": "In_Frame_Ins",
+        "splicing": "Splice_Site",
+        "unknown": "Unknown",
+    }
+    if exonic in mapping:
+        return mapping[exonic]
+    func_mapping = {
+        "splicing": "Splice_Site",
+        "UTR3": "3'UTR",
+        "UTR5": "5'UTR",
+        "intronic": "Intron",
+        "intergenic": "IGR",
+        "upstream": "5'Flank",
+        "downstream": "3'Flank",
+        "ncRNA_exonic": "RNA",
+        "ncRNA_intronic": "RNA",
+    }
+    return func_mapping.get(functional, functional if functional != "." else "Unknown")
+
+
+def main():
+    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    header = [
+        "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
+        "Chromosome",
+        "Start_Position",
+        "End_Position",
+        "Reference_Allele",
+        "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
+        "Hugo_Symbol",
+        "Variant_Classification",
+        "Variant_Type",
+        "tx",
+        "exon",
+        "txChange",
+        "aaChange",
+        "Func.refGene",
+        "Gene.refGene",
+        "GeneDetail.refGene",
+        "ExonicFunc.refGene",
+        "AAChange.refGene",
+        "FILTER",
+        "INFO",
+        "FORMAT",
+        "GENOTYPE",
+    ]
+    rows = []
+    for vcf in sorted(INPUT_DIR.glob("*.hg19_multianno.vcf")):
+        sample = vcf.name.split(".hg19_multianno.vcf", 1)[0]
+        with vcf.open() as handle:
+            for line in handle:
+                if line.startswith("#"):
+                    continue
+                parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
+                if len(parts) < 10:
+                    continue
+                chrom, pos, _id, ref, alts, _qual, filt, info, fmt, genotype = parts[:10]
+                if filt != "PASS":
+                    continue
+                info_fields = parse_info(info)
+                if "SOMATIC" not in info_fields:
+                    continue
+                gene = first_value(info_fields.get("Gene.refGene", "."))
+                if gene == ".":
+                    continue
+                func = info_fields.get("Func.refGene", ".")
+                exonic_func = info_fields.get("ExonicFunc.refGene", ".")
+                aa_ref = info_fields.get("AAChange.refGene", ".")
+                tx, exon, tx_change, aa_change = split_aa_change(aa_ref)
+                for alt in alts.split(","):
+                    end = str(int(pos) + max(len(ref), 1) - 1)
+                    rows.append([
+                        sample,
+                        chrom,
+                        pos,
+                        end,
+                        ref,
+                        alt,
+                        gene,
+                        variant_classification(func, exonic_func),
+                        variant_type(ref, alt),
+                        tx,
+                        exon,
+                        tx_change,
+                        aa_change,
+                        func,
+                        info_fields.get("Gene.refGene", "."),
+                        info_fields.get("GeneDetail.refGene", "."),
+                        exonic_func,
+                        aa_ref,
+                        filt,
+                        info,
+                        fmt,
+                        genotype,
+                    ])
+    with OUTPUT.open("w", newline="") as out:
+        writer = csv.writer(out, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
+        writer.writerow(header)
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+    print(f"Wrote {len(rows)} variants from {INPUT_DIR} to {OUTPUT}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
